description: This file defines an abstract utility class `PermissionUtil` that provides a static method to verify if runtime permissions have been granted, based on an array of grant results. It is part of an Android application dealing with runtime permissions handling.

classes.name: PermissionUtil
classes.description: An abstract utility class offering static helper methods related to runtime permissions management.

methods.name: verifyPermissions
methods.description: Checks whether all permissions in an array have been granted by verifying each entry against PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED. Returns false if any permission is denied or if the array is empty.
